info.title: Vigil
info.description: Vigil: Continuous Multimodal Oncology Surveillance & Decision-Support Aid. Research prototype — not a medical device.

post.description: Registers a new patient into the oncology surveillance roster with active consent.

schema.title: Response List Patients Api V1 Patients  Get

get.description:
View 1: Triage Queue.
Returns the complete roster of patients dynamically ordered by their latest
calculated_metastasis_risk (highest risk at the top).

schema.title: Response Get Triage Queue Api V1 Patients Triage Get

get.description: Retrieves single patient details, baseline profile, and latest risk inference.

schema.title: Response Get Patient Detail Api V1 Patients  Id  Get

post.description:
Submits primary tumor pathology and comorbidities.
Executes Model A (XGBoost) inference to compute target organ susceptibility vector,
and persists the baseline profile to database.

Submits new lab result draw.
Retrieves longitudinal lab history + baseline susceptibility.
Triggers Model B (Attention-LSTM) sequence inference.
Saves RiskInference with calculated_metastasis_risk, triage_flag, and justification_text.

get.description:
Returns full longitudinal surveillance trajectory for a patient, joining
each lab draw with its corresponding calculated_metastasis_risk, triage_flag,
and clinical justification_text.

schema.title: Response Get Patient Trajectory Api V1 Patients  Id  Trajectory Get

post.description:
'What-If' Simulation Endpoint.
Allows oncologists to project the impact of a hypothetical future lab draw
on the patient's continuous metastasis risk trajectory.

post.summary: Unit-safe observation ingestion calling M3, K2, and M5
post.description:
Unit-safe ingestion validating against Analyte Registry, executing M3 adjudication,
updating K2 sequential detector, verifying M5 clinical note, and enforcing no-dismissal invariant.

schema.title: Response List Patient Observations Api V1 Patients  Id  Observations Get

post.summary: Update or grant patient consent record
post.description: Record, revoke, or expire a patient consent record.

get.description: Retrieve surveillance alerts filtered by status.

schema.title: Response List Alerts Api V1 Alerts  Get

post.summary: Acknowledge alert with mandatory clinical disposition
post.description:
Mandatory acknowledgement disposition for alerts.

Prevents silent dismissal of clinical alerts per MASTER_PLAN §6.6.

get.summary: Export prioritized outreach list for clinic staff
get.description:
Retrieve prioritized list of patients due or overdue for surveillance follow-up.

Supports injectable simulated clock for deterministic testing and escalation checking.

schema.title: Response Get Prioritized Outreach List Api V1 Follow Up Outreach Get

post.summary: Transition follow-up task status in state machine
post.description:
Transitions a FollowUpTask to a new status (e.g. completed, declined_with_reason).

Enforces terminal absorbing state invariant.

get.summary: Verify cryptographic integrity of the audit log chain
get.description:
Iterates through all audit events, verifying backlink hashes and payload signatures.

Returns 200 with valid=True if unbroken, or valid=False with tampered_event_id.
Retrieve recent cryptographically chained audit events.

schema.title: Response List Audit Events Api V1 Audit Events Get
